description: budget.set that RAISES an existing cap (900 → 1200) with the digest of the statement rendered from the row as read (the S45 PM7.1 pattern: the commit is bound to what was read). A raise loosens authority, so without the confirm param the same request rides the confirm-required refusal with the statement and digest; with the right digest it commits, and the result says Confirmed. The statement's digest here is the SHA-256 of the statement text in this fixture — a client can recompute it.

result.statement: budget bud-epc-1: set the usd cap from 900 to 1200
